regime_context: China A-shares: Semiconductors leads (rank 1, durable trend, no crowding) with AI Compute & Optics a close challenger; only 6 of 22 themes are trend-eligible, absorbing 37% of breath. The absolute-trend gate historically did not reduce drawdown on this market (gate_helps=false), and cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0 – all leans are low-confidence directional judgments, not model extractions.
emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics is the closest challenger (rank 2, score 1.938, margin 0.129 vs. leader). Watch if the score gap compresses below 0.05 while Semiconductors’ durability bar declines below 0.5 – a potential leadership handoff (not a call). Kill the watch if Semiconductors re-accelerates and margin widens beyond 0.20.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors is the prevailing narrative with a durable trend (hurst=trend, durability_bar=0.57) and uncrowded positioning. While momentum rank alone has no forward alpha, the theme’s persistence and lack of crowding warrant a modest overweight as long as the leadership structure holds. The near-zero rank-IC and failed historical gate edge cap conviction at low.
evidence: rank: 1st with score 2.067, durable (durability_bar=0.57, hurst_tag=trend), breadth=0.364 – cohesive but not frothy
crowding_z=0.48 → not crowded; no sizing-fade signal
headline.one_narrative=false, so semiconductor dominance is not excessive; a challenger exists (AI Compute, margin 0.129)
theses.dissent: China A-shares trend-following historically showed no consistent edge; the absolute-trend gate failed to reduce drawdown in backtests. Policy pivot, tech export controls, or profit-taking could reverse the trend sharply, and momentum rank-IC is ~0, so this call is largely a bet on persistence rather than a validated anomaly.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors’ rank falls to 3 or lower, or durability_bar drops below 0.4, at any close over the next 20 trading days – indicating loss of leadership and trend health.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
